name: nextgame-ui
description: Receive locked design contracts or analyze raw UI references, compile shared requirements, build and verify Unreal UMG, and maintain versioned design and production standards.

interface.shortDescription: Design contracts, UMG builds, and specification maintenance.
interface.longDescription: Uses a deterministic structured-design route or evidence-driven raw-reference analysis to produce a reviewed UIRequirementSpec. Provides reusable specification maintenance guidance and retains independent acceptance before formal program handoff.
defaultPrompt: Receive a structured NextGame design contract without reinterpreting locked decisions.
Analyze raw UI references into a reviewed NextGame requirement before building UMG.
Maintain NextGame design rules, recipes, mappings and validation with explicit versions.
